mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(r.class_code, s.class_code) AS "classCode", COUNT(*) AS "total", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "normal", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "late", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "absent", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'LEAVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "leave" FROM student_check_in_record r LEFT JOIN check_in_activity a ON a.check_in_id = r.check_in_id LEFT JOIN student_profile s ON s.id = r.student_id WHERE r.check_date BETWEEN #{beginDate} AND #{endDate} AND a.teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId} GROUP BY COALESCE(r.class_code, s.class_code) ORDER BY COALESCE(r.class_code, s.class_code) ASC

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName, COUNT(r.id) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.checked_in = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS checkedInCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.checked_in = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missedCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.checked_in = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) / COUNT(r.id) * 100, 2) END AS checkInRate, MAX(r.check_time) AS lastCheckInTime FROM student_profile s LEFT JOIN student_check_in_record r ON r.student_id = s.id WHERE s.deleted = 0
AND s.id IN
#{studentId}
GROUP BY s.id, s.student_no, s.name ORDER BY s.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_check_in_record ( student_id, check_in_id, class_code, check_date, checked_in, status, check_time, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{checkInId}, #{classCode}, #{checkDate}, #{checkedIn}, #{status}, #{checkTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (check_in_id, student_id) WHERE check_in_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO check_in_activity ( check_in_id, course_id, course_name, title, teacher_user_id, teacher_no, start_time, end_time, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{checkInId}, #{courseId}, #{courseName}, #{title}, #{teacherUserId}, #{teacherNo}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
INSERT INTO check_in_activity_class (check_in_id, class_code) VALUES (#{checkInId}, #{classCode}) ON CONFLICT (check_in_id, class_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, check_in_id AS checkInId, course_id AS courseId, course_name AS courseName, title, teacher_user_id AS teacherUserId, teacher_no AS teacherNo, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM check_in_activity WHERE check_in_id = #{checkInId}
SELECT class_code FROM check_in_activity_class WHERE check_in_id = #{checkInId} ORDER BY class_code ASC

SELECT a.check_in_id AS checkInId, a.course_id AS courseId, a.course_name AS courseName, a.title, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_check_in_record r WHERE r.check_in_id = a.check_in_id AND r.student_id = #{studentId} ) AS checkedIn FROM check_in_activity a JOIN check_in_activity_class ac ON ac.check_in_id = a.check_in_id WHERE ac.class_code = #{classCode} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.start_time <= #{now} AND a.end_time >= #{now} ORDER BY a.end_time ASC
